# Button · الأزرار

Generated from the public TypeScript API and authored guidance. Source digest: `9765b7dc6bc3df7734e533c06e0d25e3f0bf5d05888a88e8abbe9dee331795a0`.

Trigger an action in the current workflow.

Avoid: Navigation requiring an anchor or router link.

## Setup

Read [integration](../integration.md). Import `Button` from the installed manifest's entry; load its styles once and use SystemProvider.

## Common props

| Prop | Type | Required | Runtime default expression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `ButtonVariant \| undefined` | no | "primary" |
| state | `ButtonState \| undefined` | no | "idle" |
| size | `"sm" \| "md" \| undefined` | no | "sm" |
| iconOnly | `boolean \| undefined` | no | false |
| aria-label | `string \| undefined` | no | — |
| disabled | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| type | `"submit" \| "reset" \| "button" \| undefined` | no | "button" |
| children | `ReactNode` | no | — |
| onClick | `MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement> \| undefined` | no | — |
| className | `string \| undefined` | no | "" |

Full inherited API and conditional branches: [contract](../../../knowledge/api/Button.json). Related types are included there. Do not interpret this concise table as the complete inherited API.

## Rules

- iconOnly=true requires a meaningful aria-label.
- Loading disables repeated clicks and exposes aria-busy. The application owns async work and state transitions.
- Use type=submit for form submission; the default is button.
- Native button attributes are supported; no asChild prop is exposed.

## Parts

- **root**: button; className and native attributes target this element
- **label**: internal span; state icons are managed by the component

## Example

See the [compiling examples](../../../src/examples/Components.tsx). The workbench editor is a demonstration model, not the runtime API.

# Dropdown menu · القائمة المنسدلة

Generated from the public TypeScript API and authored guidance. Source digest: `9765b7dc6bc3df7734e533c06e0d25e3f0bf5d05888a88e8abbe9dee331795a0`.

Contextual actions for a record or page.

Avoid: Form value selection; use a suitable select control instead.

## Setup

Read [integration](../integration.md). Import `DropdownMenu` from the installed manifest's entry; load its styles once and use SystemProvider.

## Common props

| Prop | Type | Required | Runtime default expression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| trigger | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| import("react").JSXElementConstructor<any>>` | yes | — |
| items | `MenuItem[]` | yes | — |
| align | `"end" \| "start" \| undefined` | no | "start" |
| open | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| onOpenChange | `((open: boolean) => void) \| undefined` | no | — |

Full inherited API and conditional branches: [contract](../../../knowledge/api/DropdownMenu.json). Related types are included there. Do not interpret this concise table as the complete inherited API.

## Rules

- trigger is one ReactElement capable of receiving Radix trigger props; use Tiraz Button.
- Items have unique IDs, string labels and application onSelect callbacks. Disabled actions cannot run.
- Controlled open requires onOpenChange. Uncontrolled opening is managed internally.
- No children, className, side or ref prop is exposed. align uses logical start/end.
- Reuse the provider portal context, including menus nested in Sheet.

## Parts

- **trigger**: caller element
- **menu**: managed non-modal portal
- **item**: configured through MenuItem

## Example

See the [compiling examples](../../../src/examples/Components.tsx). The workbench editor is a demonstration model, not the runtime API.

# Sheet · اللوحة الجانبية

Generated from the public TypeScript API and authored guidance. Source digest: `9765b7dc6bc3df7734e533c06e0d25e3f0bf5d05888a88e8abbe9dee331795a0`.

Details or editing without leaving the current page.

Avoid: A small contextual action menu or a navigation destination.

## Setup

Read [integration](../integration.md). Import `Sheet` from the installed manifest's entry; load its styles once and use SystemProvider.

## Common props

| Prop | Type | Required | Runtime default expression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| trigger | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| import("react").JSXElementConstructor<any>>` | yes | — |
| title | `string` | yes | — |
| description | `string` | yes | — |
| closeLabel | `string` | yes | — |
| children | `ReactNode` | yes | — |
| footer | `ReactNode` | no | — |
| open | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| onOpenChange | `((open: boolean) => void) \| undefined` | no | — |
| side | `"right" \| "left" \| undefined` | no | — |

Full inherited API and conditional branches: [contract](../../../knowledge/api/Sheet.json). Related types are included there. Do not interpret this concise table as the complete inherited API.

## Rules

- title, description and closeLabel are required accessible copy.
- side accepts physical left/right; omitted means right in RTL and left in LTR.
- trigger is one ReactElement; use Tiraz Button. Content and footer accept ReactNode.
- For asynchronous forms, close only after successful save and retain input on failure.
- Escape/backdrop/close restore focus. Nested overlays inherit the Sheet container.
- SheetClose is the public dismissal helper for footer buttons.

## Parts

- **trigger**: caller element
- **overlay**: managed backdrop
- **content**: modal dialog with nested portal context
- **footer**: caller ReactNode

## Example

See the [compiling examples](../../../src/examples/Components.tsx). The workbench editor is a demonstration model, not the runtime API.

# Switch · مفتاح التبديل

Generated from the public TypeScript API and authored guidance. Source digest: `9765b7dc6bc3df7734e533c06e0d25e3f0bf5d05888a88e8abbe9dee331795a0`.

A labeled on/off preference.

Avoid: Choosing among multiple mutually exclusive options.

## Setup

Read [integration](../integration.md). Import `Switch` from the installed manifest's entry; load its styles once and use SystemProvider.

## Common props

| Prop | Type | Required | Runtime default expression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` | yes | — |
| description | `string \| undefined` | no | — |
| checked | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| defaultChecked | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| onCheckedChange | `((checked: boolean) => void) \| undefined` | no | — |
| disabled | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| required | `boolean \| undefined` | no | — |
| name | `string \| undefined` | no | — |
| value | `string \| number \| readonly string[] \| undefined` | no | — |
| id | `string \| undefined` | no | — |
| className | `string \| undefined` | no | "" |
| style | `CSSProperties \| undefined` | no | — |
| ref | `Ref<HTMLButtonElement> \| undefined` | no | — |

Full inherited API and conditional branches: [contract](../../../knowledge/api/Switch.json). Related types are included there. Do not interpret this concise table as the complete inherited API.

## Rules

- label is required and linked to the control. description is combined with caller aria-describedby.
- Choose controlled checked/onCheckedChange or uncontrolled defaultChecked.
- Native Radix Switch.Root props are inherited except children and asChild; the wrapper owns Thumb markup.
- className targets the label wrapper; style, ref and native attributes target the control.

## Parts

- **wrapper**: label and control layout; className target
- **control**: Radix root; style/ref/native attributes target
- **thumb**: managed internally

## Example

See the [compiling examples](../../../src/examples/Components.tsx). The workbench editor is a demonstration model, not the runtime API.

# Tabs · التبويبات

Generated from the public TypeScript API and authored guidance. Source digest: `9765b7dc6bc3df7734e533c06e0d25e3f0bf5d05888a88e8abbe9dee331795a0`.

Switch between related panels within one context.

Avoid: Site navigation or unrelated routed pages.

## Setup

Read [integration](../integration.md). Import `Tabs` from the installed manifest's entry; load its styles once and use SystemProvider.

## Common props

| Prop | Type | Required | Runtime default expression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items | `TabItem[]` | yes | — |
| label | `string` | yes | — |
| value | `string \| undefined` | no | — |
| defaultValue | `string \| undefined` | no | items.find((item) => !item.disabled)?.value |
| onValueChange | `((value: string) => void) \| undefined` | no | — |
| variant | `"underline" \| "segment" \| undefined` | no | "underline" |
| className | `string \| undefined` | no | "" |

Full inherited API and conditional branches: [contract](../../../knowledge/api/Tabs.json). Related types are included there. Do not interpret this concise table as the complete inherited API.

## Rules

- Provide a descriptive label for the tab list and unique item values.
- Controlled value requires onValueChange to update application state; otherwise use defaultValue.
- Item label and content accept ReactNode. The workbench's string editor and collection limit are not runtime API restrictions.
- Direction comes from SystemProvider; preserve keyboard navigation.

## Parts

- **root**: className targets Tabs root
- **list**: managed tablist and active indicator
- **panel**: content supplied through items

## Example

See the [compiling examples](../../../src/examples/Components.tsx). The workbench editor is a demonstration model, not the runtime API.

# Toast · التنبيهات

Generated from the public TypeScript API and authored guidance. Source digest: `9765b7dc6bc3df7734e533c06e0d25e3f0bf5d05888a88e8abbe9dee331795a0`.

Brief success, error or information feedback after an action.

Avoid: The only presentation of a persistent form error or information requiring a decision.

## Setup

Read [integration](../integration.md). Import `ToastProvider` from the installed manifest's entry; load its styles once and use SystemProvider.

## Common props

| Prop | Type | Required | Runtime default expression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `ReactNode` | yes | — |
| label | `string` | yes | — |
| closeLabel | `string` | yes | — |

Full inherited API and conditional branches: [contract](../../../knowledge/api/ToastProvider.json). Related types are included there. Do not interpret this concise table as the complete inherited API.

## Rules

- Wrap callers in ToastProvider inside SystemProvider; invoke useToast within that provider.
- Supply translated provider label and closeLabel; toast() accepts ToastMessage.
- At most three active entries are retained. Default duration is 5000 ms; hover/focus pauses expiry.
- Events and business state belong to the application. No string-evaluated callbacks.

## Parts

- **provider**: notification lifecycle
- **viewport**: scoped notification region
- **message**: title, optional description, tone and duration

## Example

See the [compiling examples](../../../src/examples/Components.tsx). The workbench editor is a demonstration model, not the runtime API.

# Integrating Tiraz

Start with `tiraz.project.json` in the consumer project. Its `entry`, `styles`, `patternsEntry`, `knowledge` and `docs` paths are relative to that manifest's directory. Resolve imports relative to the file being edited (or through the consumer's configured aliases). Do not assume a `./system` import or the original Tiraz checkout.

## Source installation

From a Tiraz checkout, run `node scripts/install.mjs /absolute/path/to/consumer [src/tiraz]`. The target project must exist. The optional destination is relative to it. Installation refuses existing targets and manifests; it does not install packages or edit your application/package.json. It prints required dependencies and writes a manifest with hashes. Review the changes and install the listed dependencies using your project's package manager. Keep your existing React 19 installation compatible.

Import the manifest's `styles` once at the client entry. This loads local IBM Plex Sans Arabic 400/500/600, semantic tokens, component styles, and pattern styles. No Tailwind setup is needed by copied Tiraz runtime code.

Import `SystemProvider` and `defaultConfig` from the manifest's `entry`. Wrap the application (or the desired scoped subtree) once:

```tsx
<SystemProvider config={{ ...defaultConfig, direction: "rtl", theme: "light" }}>
  {children}
</SystemProvider>
```

For notifications, place `ToastProvider` inside SystemProvider and above components calling `useToast()`. Supply translated `label` and `closeLabel`. Reuse existing providers; a new provider around each generated control can change scoping and state.

The example module is available at the manifest's `examples` path. It demonstrates all six components, nested overlays, mixed-direction content, and notifications without importing the workbench. Business actions in examples only demonstrate event wiring; connect production callbacks to your application.

## Supported environment

React 19, TypeScript, browser-based Vite. SSR/Next.js and other environments require their own integration tests; they are not claimed supported here. Node 24.15 or newer is required for the repository toolchain. The runtime itself runs in the browser.

## Updates

Keep the installed manifest with copied source. `node scripts/install.mjs --verify /absolute/path/to/consumer` checks each installed file against recorded hashes and reports modifications/missing files. Install a newer revision into a separate directory or disposable project and review a diff. Do not overwrite local customizations automatically. Hashes detect changes, not trustworthiness of a remote source.

## Registry

`npm run registry:build` writes `public/r/registry.json` and `public/r/tiraz-system.json`. The single source item contains the complete system, examples, patterns, docs, and dependency list. It targets `src/tiraz` and `tiraz.project.json`; use the local installer for another directory. The registry is prepared locally; no public URL is implied. Publish those generated files at an actual chosen host before configuring a remote namespace. Never invent a registry URL.

# Tiraz usage rules

- Read the consumer manifest and the relevant component contract before generating code. Use real public exports; report missing capabilities explicitly.
- Runtime TypeScript owns API facts. Authored guidance explains intent. The workbench editor has narrower serializable values and does not define library limits.
- Preserve Radix interaction/focus behavior and provider portal scoping. Do not reimplement an existing control with generic markup.
- Use semantic tokens for design choices. Do not hardcode accent colors to reproduce a screenshot. Theme, accent, density, typography, radius and reduced motion belong to SystemConfig.
- Arabic/RTL is the default. Use logical CSS properties; isolate emails, URLs and identifiers with bdi or explicit direction. Mirror directional icons only; do not mirror logos, numbers or media controls indiscriminately.
- Language, regional locale, numbering system and text direction are separate decisions. Use the application's locale for Intl number/date formatting. Supply translated labels and errors to patterns.
- Use callback functions for application actions; do not serialize/evaluate JavaScript strings. Represent async pending/success/error in state; no simulated timers in production save logic.
- Prefer supported props and documented parts. Do not assume every component accepts className, children, ref, asChild or all native attributes.
- Ensure icon-only actions have accessible names, form inputs have labels, and errors persist near the relevant form. Toasts supplement persistent errors.
- Validate generated code in the actual consumer. Compile, test meaningful interactions and inspect RTL/LTR, light/dark, keyboard focus, reduced motion and long labels. Automated axe results do not establish full accessibility conformance.
